subject.title: Refactor dead and duplicated code across app surfaces

question: Which app-surface cleanup cluster should this issue authorize first, and what validation gate should prove that slice?
rationale: The title is directionally aligned with repository policy, but the empty body and protected maintainer label leave the concrete target and review boundary to maintainer intent.

options.title: Scope One Cleanup Slice
options.body: Name one UI, iOS, Android, macOS, or shared-app duplicate/dead-code cluster and keep the first PR limited to that surface with focused tests.

options.title: Convert To A Checklist
options.body: Keep this issue open as a maintainer checklist and add concrete sub-items before any implementation branch starts.

options.title: Close After Filing Narrow Issues
options.body: If maintainers do not want a broad placeholder, close it only after replacing it with specific cleanup issues or PRs.

recommendation.title: Scope One Cleanup Slice
recommendation.body: Name one UI, iOS, Android, macOS, or shared-app duplicate/dead-code cluster and keep the first PR limited to that surface with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened and self-assigned the maintainer issue and have recent cleanup history on the affected UI surface.
